subject: case studies of MD based drug discovery

messages.author: Vaibhav Dixit
messages.body:
Dear All,
After browsing through some papers (links below), I get the feeling that
lead optimization work might already be actively pursued by many MD+pharma
experts.
But these papers (by Amber group and others) seem to discuss only
retrospective studies besides the basics.
Thus just wondering if someone on the list is aware of any case studies
where MD based methods played a significant role in identifying a compound
that at least underwent clinical trials for drug discovery/development.
Or is it still a promise waiting to be delivered?
I'm sure that the efforts of the experts here and elsewhere will make it a
reality sometime soon. :)
https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acs.jcim.0c00613
https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acs.jmedchem.5b01684
Thank you.
-- 
Regards,
Dr. Vaibhav A. Dixit,
Assistant Professor,
Department of Pharmacy,
